![](media/c2-4/media/image168.emf)
solution:
Ta có$\left\{ \begin{array}{r}
\mathit{v}_{1}\mathbf{=}\frac{\Delta\mathit{d}_{1}}{\Delta\mathit{t}_{1}}\mathbf{=}\frac{\mathbf{-}60}{1,5}\mathbf{= -}40\ km/h \\
\mathit{v}_{2}\mathbf{=}\frac{\Delta\mathit{d}_{2}}{\Delta\mathit{t}_{2}}\mathbf{=}\frac{30}{0,5}\mathbf{=}60\ km/h
\end{array} \right.\ \mathbf{\Rightarrow}\mathit{v}\mathbf{=}\mathit{v}_{1}\mathbf{+}\mathit{v}_{2}\mathbf{= -}40\mathbf{+}60\mathbf{=}20\ km/h.$
